description: Maize Ac/Ds (hAT family): a Ds element mobilised by Ac transposase; 8-bp target-site duplication, no strong target motif.

ds_primer_tail.description: Reads carry a short tag, then the Ds primer and Ds end (GTATTTTACCGACCGTTACCGACCGTTTTCATCCCTA), then the genome. The primer and end are trimmed wherever they occur at full length; reads without them are discarded; Illumina adaptor read-through is trimmed from the 3' end.
used_by: Segal et al. 2018 (C. albicans Ds-NAT1, PRJNA490565)

satay_restriction.description: SATAY: reads start in the genome at the MiniDs junction and run to the first DpnII (GATC) or NlaIII (CATG) site, after which the circularised Ds sequence follows. The Ds sequence after the site is trimmed from the 3' end, together with Illumina adaptor read-through.
used_by: Michel et al. 2017 (S. cerevisiae MiniDs, ArrayExpress E-MTAB-4885 / ENA ERP016475)
Kingma et al. 2025 (S. cerevisiae nrp1 SATAY, HiSeq X runs of ArrayExpress E-MTAB-14476 / ENA ERP164453)

satay_ds_end.description: SATAY with the Ds end in the read: a short tag, the MiniDs end (TTTACCGACCGTTACCGACCGTTTTCATCCCTA), sometimes twice, then the genome to the first DpnII or NlaIII site and the circularised Ds sequence. Up to two copies of the end are trimmed; reads without it (which start on the restriction-site side) are discarded; the Ds sequence after the site and Illumina read-through are trimmed from the 3' end.
used_by: Kingma et al. 2025 (S. cerevisiae wild-type SATAY replicates, NovaSeq runs of ArrayExpress E-MTAB-14476 / ENA ERP164453)
satay_ds_end.source: read structure checked on 2,000 reads of ERR13705629 (47% carry the Ds end; 72% of those map at MAPQ >= 20, the rest include the ADE2 donor locus and concatemers)
